story_title: A Hike in Pine Ridge Park
task_instruction: Rewrite each affirmative statement as a negative question.
paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Alex and Priya began a hike in Pine Ridge Park. {{red:They can see the trail map from the entrance.}} {{mask_1}}? They stop to check the route. {{red:Alex can carry the extra water.}} {{mask_2}}? Priya gives him one bottle.

At the first sign, they read the safety rules. {{red:Hikers must stay on the marked path.}} {{mask_3}}? The friends follow the blue trail markers. {{red:They should take a paper map.}} {{mask_4}}? Priya has one in her backpack. {{red:Alex will need a warm jacket at the top.}} {{mask_5}}? The weather is cool near the ridge.

They reach a fork in the trail. {{red:They could take the shorter path.}} {{mask_6}}? A park worker says that path is closed for repairs. {{red:Visitors can use the wooden bridge.}} {{mask_7}}? The worker points to the open crossing. {{red:They can cross the stream here.}} {{mask_8}}? Alex checks the bridge before they step onto it.

The trail climbs through the trees. {{red:Priya can walk up the steep section.}} {{mask_9}}? She takes a short break and drinks some water. {{red:They should rest in the shade.}} {{mask_10}}? Alex finds a bench beside the path. {{red:They must leave the trail clean.}} {{mask_11}}? They put their snack wrappers back in the bag.

At noon, the hikers stop at a picnic area. {{red:They can eat at the tables.}} {{mask_12}}? A family is using one table, so they choose another. {{red:Alex will eat the fruit now.}} {{mask_13}}? He saves it for the walk back. {{red:They should refill their water bottles.}} {{mask_14}}? A drinking fountain is beside the shelter.

After lunch, they continue toward the ridge. {{red:They can reach the viewpoint before two.}} {{mask_15}}? Priya checks the time and pace. {{red:Alex might need another short break.}} {{mask_16}}? He has been walking steadily for an hour. {{red:They should take the left fork.}} {{mask_17}}? The trail map shows that the viewpoint is on the right.

At the viewpoint, the friends take a few photos. {{red:They must stay behind the safety rail.}} {{mask_18}}? The sign beside the platform gives the same instruction. {{red:They could see the lake through the clouds.}} {{mask_19}}? The view becomes clearer as the clouds move away. Before they leave, Priya checks their supplies. {{red:They have to start back before sunset.}} {{mask_20}}? They begin the return walk with plenty of daylight.
